t: This is Pearson, a British education and assessment company headquartered in London. It provides learning materials, assessments, qualifications, virtual learning and English-language learning. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange, is part of the FTSE 100, and also has a listing in New York. In 2025 it reported revenue of 3.6 billion pounds, with about seventeen thousand employees on average. It was founded by Samuel Pearson, an English entrepreneur who lived from 1814 to 1884.
